§r§uMiracles Technique
§5§o- This technique erases most little miracles from your life and stores them,
which is shown by the marks under your eyes.
These stored miracles are released when your life is in danger,
altering your luck to ensure you survive or evade would-be fatal blows.
When a miracle has been used, the marking turns to white.

§r§g  - Click to use Miracles Technique

§cThis technique will not save you from Every Attack, it will only save you when you are already close to death!
